title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: runbook autodiagnostics & on-call helpers
author: Marisol Vega
description: Motivation: Improve on-call efficiency by linking SLO autodiagnostics to curated runbooks and providing compact on-call helper utilities in incident-bot. This change bridges the slo-toolkit autodiagnostics and incident-bot runbook workflows so when an SLO alert triggers, the bot can surface the most relevant runbooks, relevant diagnostic snippets, and suggested remediation steps. Summary of changes: - Add runbook matching & ranking in slo-toolkit autodiagnostics to emit runbook candidates with confidence scores. - Add incident-bot helpers to resolve runbook links, render compact runbook previews, and attach suggested runbook steps to on-call messages. - Introduce a small runbooks.yaml format for lightweight metadata (tags, severity, owner) and a loader used by both tools. - Tests for matching logic, e2e scenario for incident-bot message flow, and updated docs. Backwards compatibility: the runbooks loader supports legacy storage and falls back to existing oncall-runbook storage when no runbooks.yaml is present. Rollout: feature gated behind 'runbook_autolink' feature flag in incident-bot config; default off for existing clusters. Related Linear items: ENG-2781 (runbook autolink ranking), SRE-301 (oncall UX improvements). Checklist: - [x] unit tests for matcher - [x] integration tests for incident-bot message flow - [x] docs update - [x] feature flag gating - [x] audit + security scan signed off Implementation notes: matching uses a lightweight tokenized tag intersection + TF-IDF style score from slo-toolkit; results include confidence, tags matched, and top matched sections so incident-bot can show a 1-line preview and link to full runbook. Performance: matcher implemented in Go for slo-toolkit path, with a Python shim used by incident-bot in hosted deployments where Python runtime is already used. Observability: emits metrics slo_toolkit.runbook_matches and incident_bot.runbook_attached with labels (slo, severity, matched_tags). Testing: unit/integration tests added; CI pipeline reran to address a flakey e2e test (see comments). Merge: squash and merge.

release_notes: Add runbook autolink between slo-toolkit autodiagnostics and incident-bot: incident-bot can now surface ranked runbook suggestions and compact previews in on-call messages. Feature is behind the 'runbook_autolink' feature flag.
security_notes: Security scan completed: no high severity findings. Runbook metadata intentionally minimal to avoid leaking PII; incident-bot only exposes runbook slugs and public steps in chat messages.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for matcher logic; integration tests validate go <-> python shim interaction; e2e validates message flow with feature flag on. CI had one flaky e2e run that passed after timeout stabilization.
changelog_entry: slo-toolkit: add runbook matcher; incident-bot: attach runbook suggestions to alerts (feature-flagged)
notes_for_ops: Enable feature by setting incident-bot.config.runbook_autolink=true and ensure runbooks.yaml is deployed to the config path. Monitor slo_toolkit.runbook_matches and incident_bot.runbook_attached metrics for initial rollout.
